title: Remove “Shop Our Products” heading from storefront

requirements.summary: Remove the “Shop Our Products” heading from the storefront products section without affecting the product grid or shopping flow.
acceptanceCriteria: On the storefront page, the section heading that currently reads “Shop Our Products” is no longer shown to customers.
The product listing/grid still renders as before and remains accessible on the storefront page.
No other customer-facing location shows the exact text “Shop Our Products”.

file_operations.description: Remove or replace the products-section heading text so the exact customer-facing string “Shop Our Products” is no longer rendered, while leaving the products section structure and product grid rendering logic unchanged.
